theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Energy (+1.57%) and Technology (+0.82%) led the market today, while Health Care (-1.52%) and Communication Svcs (-1.30%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged -0.20%, defensives -0.72%, and value/cyclicals +0.11% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 +0.21%, Dow -0.03%, Nasdaq +0.34% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps bucked the broader trend, with the Russell 2000 up +0.65%, outperforming large caps. The VIX rose 0.98% to 16.48, pointing to a bit more caution creeping in beneath the surface. Gold added 0.03% to $4,206.70, crude oil was little changed at $91.91, and bitcoin gained 1.63% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
